title: SlotFlow-GB: A Neural Framework for Trans-Dimensional Inference of Overlapping Galactic Binaries
abstract: arXiv:2611.26057v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) will observe the millihertz gravitational-wave sky, including millions of long-lived Galactic binaries (GBs), tens of thousands of which are expected to be individually resolvable throughout the mission's lifetime. Extracting these sources requires jointly determining their number and physical parameters from strongly overlapping signals, posing a computationally demanding trans-dimensional inference problem. We introduce SlotFlow-GB, a neural framework that constructs a learned approximation to the trans-dimensional posterior, producing a probability distribution over source multiplicity and parameter densities for individual binaries in a single evaluation, without requiring their number to be specified in advance. translated_title: SlotFlow-GB：用于重叠银河系双星跨维度推断的神经框架
translated_abstract: 激光干涉空间天线（LISA）将观测毫赫兹频段的引力波天空，其中包括数百万个长寿命的银河系双星（GBs），预计其中数万个在整个任务运行期间可被单独分辨。提取这些信号源需要从强重叠信号中联合确定它们的数量和物理参数，这是一个计算需求极高的跨维度推断问题。我们提出了SlotFlow-GB，一个神经框架，它构建了对跨维度后验的学习近似，能够在单次评估中产生关于源数量的概率分布以及各个双星的参数密度分布，而无需预先指定源的数量。我们使用包含2 μHz频率区间内多达十个双星、为期一年的LISA模拟演示了该框架，并重点关注源……（摘要在此处被截断）的高信噪比情形。
tldr: SlotFlow-GB是一种神经框架，通过学习跨维度后验的近似，可在单次评估中同时推断强重叠银河系双星的数量及其物理参数，无需预先指定源的数目。
